description: This file is a shell script used for testing the functionality of git submodule fetch, specifically testing recursive fetch behavior, configuration overrides, submodule updating, and various edge cases in a git repository environment.

methods.name: write_expected_sub
methods.description: Generates expected error output for fetching a submodule.

methods.name: write_expected_sub2
methods.description: Generates expected error output for fetching second submodule.

methods.name: write_expected_deep
methods.description: Generates expected error output for fetching a nested deep submodule.

methods.name: write_expected_super
methods.description: Generates expected error output for fetching a super project.

methods.name: add_submodule_commits
methods.description: Creates new commits in submodules and writes expected output files.

methods.name: add_superproject_commits
methods.description: Updates submodules in superproject, commits, and writes expected output.

methods.name: verify_fetch_result
methods.description: Verifies that the actual fetch stderr matches the expected output files.

methods.name: add_commit_push
methods.description: Adds files, commits, and pushes in a specified directory.

methods.name: compare_refs_in_dir
methods.description: Compares commit hashes between two directories/branches.

methods.name: fetch_with_recursion_abort
methods.description: Runs a fetch with recursion and halts on detected recursion to prevent infinite loops.
